LocaleLayout.title: TechToJob — Community of developers and tech companies in Spanish
LocaleLayout.description: Spanish-speaking community of developers and tech companies. Tournaments, jobs, and people who see you work before a role opens.

OgImage.eyebrow: Community of developers and tech companies
OgImage.title: Stop sending CVs into the void
OgImage.subtitle: Build, participate, and let people see you work before a job opening even exists.

NotFound.title: That page does not exist
NotFound.description: The link is broken, mistyped, or we moved it. Head back to the home and start from there.

Hero.headline: Sending out tons of applications and getting zero replies?
Hero.subtitle: It's not a talent gap — it's a visibility gap. TechToJob is the community where developers and companies cross paths every day, not just when a role opens.

HowItWorks.title: From your first message to your next opportunity
HowItWorks.subtitle: Four steps. No endless forms. No ATS filtering out your CV before a human ever reads it.

one.label: Step 1
one.title: Join the Discord
one.description: Say hi in #introductions and you're in. Takes less than a minute.

two.label: Step 2
two.title: Show up
two.description: Answer questions, share what you know, jump into a tournament. People start recognizing you.

threeA.label: Step 3a
threeA.title: Post your profile
threeA.description: Stack, level, and availability. Companies in the community check it when they're hiring.

threeB.label: Step 3b
threeB.title: Post your role
threeB.description: Describe what you need and access profiles of people who've already worked with you inside.

four.label: Step 4
four.title: Direct contact
four.description: Talk to the person who decides, not a form. The opportunity comes from showing up.

highlight.title: Free for candidates
highlight.description: And no automatic filter discarding your CV before a human reads it.

Talent.title: Let them find you, not the other way around
Talent.subtitle: Post your profile: stack, level, and availability. When a company in the community looks for someone like you, they check it and reach out directly.
Talent.details: No résumés lost in an ATS. A human reads it — not an algorithm filtering you out for a keyword you didn't include. You don't need years of experience either — if you're just starting out, say so.

Companies.title: See how they work before you hire
Companies.subtitle: Post the role and access profiles of people already active in the community: tournaments, technical channels, helping others out.
Companies.details: It's not a CV full of adjectives. It's seeing how someone thinks before day one. Fewer screening interviews, more conversations with people who actually fit.

Tournaments.title: Learn by competing, not by watching tutorials
Tournaments.subtitle: Every tournament has a real challenge, a deadline, and a jury that evaluates with public criteria, not by gut feeling. Win or lose, you finish with something worth showing in an interview.

Networking.title: The best roles aren't found — they're heard about
Networking.subtitle: Channels per area, people in the field answering questions in minutes, roles someone shares because they know who's hiring. This is where you hear about them.

Testimonials.title: Real stories from inside the community
Testimonials.subtitle: Gathered in the server, not through a form. Each person links to their LinkedIn.

one.quote: I stopped sending CVs into the void. Two weeks inside the server and I had three calls with companies that were already active in the channels.
one.name: Andrea Morales

two.quote: I hired someone who'd already been answering questions in the channel. I went into the interview knowing exactly how they think.
two.name: Diego Hernández

three.quote: The tournament gave me something real to show. I didn't have to make anything up in the interview — I showed the repo.
three.name: Pablo Reyes

four.quote: What I value most is that people reply seriously. It's not another dead Discord full of emojis.
four.name: Sara Ortega

five.quote: I found my first tech mentor here. They've been answering my questions almost daily for two years.
five.name: Lucía Castillo

six.quote: We posted a role and within 48 hours we had five reviewable profiles. I'm not going back to LinkedIn.
six.name: Carmen Vega

seven.quote: As a recruiter, this is the only channel where candidates speak with code before the interview.
seven.name: Iván Soto

eight.quote: I started answering questions and now I'm a maintainer of an open-source project that came out of here.
eight.name: Marcos Gil

News.title: What's happening at TechToJob
News.subtitle: Tournament results, things from the industry, and movement inside the community.

featured.title: Tournament #2 closes: 31 submissions and a podium we didn't see coming
featured.excerpt: Seven days, a landing in production, and 31 submissions evaluated with public criteria. Here are the winning projects, the jury's decisions, and why three people went from participating to receiving offers that same week.

one.title: We've crossed 1,200 people on Discord
one.excerpt: A symbolic threshold: what started as a chat channel for friends is now a community with its own life. Here's what we learned along the way.

two.title: Why ATS keeps failing junior candidates (and what to do about it)
two.excerpt: We analyzed 200 tech job postings in Spain and what we found is worse than we thought. A read with real numbers.

Newsletter.title: One email a week, no more
Newsletter.subtitle: Every Monday: new roles inside the community, tournaments opening up, and things worth your time from the industry. No spam. One-click unsubscribe.

preview.label: This is how one looks
preview.subject: Mon 15 · 8 new roles and a tournament opening today
preview.body: This week there are 8 new roles inside the community (3 senior, 2 mid, 3 junior) and the registration for Tournament #3 opens now — the challenge is published today at 6pm.
preview.footer: If you want to stop receiving these, there's a link at the bottom of every email. But you won't need it: we never send more than one a week.

form.consent: By signing up you agree to receive one email per week. Unsubscribe whenever you want.

Closing.title: If you've read this far, you already know what comes next
Closing.titleHighlight: you already know what comes next
Closing.subtitle: TechToJob isn't for everyone. It's for people who'd rather be seen working than fill out forms. If that's you, we'll see you inside.
